usages.explain: Expresses disdain for the matter brought up, suggesting "that's crazy, not worth caring about, not worth doing". It's an informal way of saying [など... ものか].

examples.content: その家なんか帰るものか。
examples.transcription: そのいえなんかかえるものか。
examples.mean: Will I ever go back to that house?

examples.content: あの店のサービスは最低だ。二度となんか行くものか。
examples.transcription: あのみせのさーびすはさいていだ。にどとなんかいくものか。
examples.mean: The service at that store is the worst. Will I ever go anywhere again?

title: なんか…ものか => Absolutely no desire to do...
